_doc: Thresholds of tools/standalone/gameplay_regress/gr_check.py. value = what the check compares with, orig = what the ORIGINAL exe showed (record_baseline.py / -o fills it), why = why the tolerance is what it is. A run with -o compares against the original run of THAT run instead.

foot_pickups_min.why: exe CPed::CreateDeadPedWeaponPickups (0x459xxx): an armed ped that dies on foot drops its weapons as pickups; the LAPD cop carries a pistol and a nightstick (2 pickups seen). Deterministic: >= 1.

hit_drop_min.why: a pistol damage event of 10 lowered CJ's health+armour by 4 (the exe scales damage to the player); the check only needs 'damage arrives', the 0xFD-fill bug made hits do nothing.

law_arrive_s.orig: 1 s after the wanted level appeared
law_arrive_s.why: cops spawn at once at 2+ stars; the original's first cop car was near within 1 s of the wanted level and parked beside CJ within 6 s; 40 s leaves a wide margin for the randomness of spawning, a build whose cops never appear fails.

engage_s.orig: 13 s after the wanted level appeared (first sign)
engage_s.why: the chase has randomness (PT-COMBAT: in the alley the original's cop cars idle at 25-50 m for 40 s, elsewhere CJ is busted within 25 s), so ANY sign of engagement within the 70 s window counts: cop on foot, pursuit/arrest/kill task, CJ hurt, busted.

coll_used_max.why: collision-list entries in use: the original peaked at 7 (one-shot <= 2) in this scene, the fixed port at 2-6; without the UpdateParameters override one-shot entries are never released (mutant: 10 in the 120 s scene, 99 in the 6.5 min one) - the end-of-run checks below are the sharper test, this is the cap.

coll_used_end_max.why: 25 s after the last contact: the original still held 6 LOOPING entries (water / scrape loops); everything one-shot is gone. Cap 10 = original + margin.

coll_oneshot_end_max.why: one-shot (not looping) entries still allocated after 25 s of idling: original max 2, fixed port 0-1; the mutant without the override kept 9 for ever.

coll_loop_end_max.why: looping collision entries at the end: the original held 6.

act_max.why: active sounds of the 300-entry table: original max 37, fixed port 25-33 in the same scene; a leak of endless looped sounds grows without bound; 60 leaves room for the scene's randomness.

ch_max.why: hardware channels in use: 47 is the hard limit of the sound manager (original max 37).

want_max.why: audible sounds without a hardware channel: 0 in the original, 0 in the fixed port.

loop_snd_max.why: looped sounds (ambient loops + engines): original max 27, fixed port 21-28; stuck collision loops add to it.

sweep_min_deg.why: one raw 40 x 100 px sweep turned the camera by 1253 deg in the fixed build (relative mouse mode); with relative mode off (mutant) the same sweep gives 150 deg (the cursor runs into the window edge); 360 separates them with a wide margin.

sweep_repeat_ratio.why: the next sweeps (cursor already at the screen edge in the broken build) must turn the camera at least half as much as the first.

cop_dz_max_dm.why: cops inside the station stand on the floor CJ stands on (peds are placed on the floor at spawn): |dz| <= 1 m; the playtest saw them spawn on top of CJ (measured 1.4 m and 2.5 m above him at 4 s after entering, 0 later when they had dropped).

cheats.why:
state of the ORIGINAL exe after each cheat press of routes/cheats.txt (recorded The system cannot accept the date entered.
Enter the new date: (mm-dd-yy) from orig_probe.log); traffic is random, so only the SET of vehicle models a press added is compared; hp / hour / pveh are not compared (the AI and the clock move)
